study: What the engine itself does with every standard Map16 tile id, measured by writing each id into the level buffer at a controlled rig position and reading the engine's own collision, death, coin and freeze responses.

protocol.class_rule: harmful: contact killed a small Mario; interact: the engine froze the player without killing him; coin: contact paid the coin counter or consumed the cell; slope: held up with the rest inside the cell's vertical span; platform: held up from above without blocking the side; solid: the side flag fired or the run stopped short; decor: the engine ignored the tile
